description: handle_mdn_send Step 5 (mdn.rs:248-265) calls get_objects::<Email> once per entry to check the $mdnsent keyword. The MdnBackend::send_mdns implementation then fetches the same email a second time (tests/common/mod.rs:2299-2306) to read the Disposition-Notification-To header and extract server-set fields. In any storage backend backed by a real data store (database, network RPC) this is two round-trips per send entry where one would suffice. Fix: pass the already-fetched email into send_mdns, or merge the keyword check and the header check into a single fetch inside send_mdns (and remove the handler pre-fetch). The trait signature for send_mdns would need to change to accept pre-fetched email data, or the handler pre-check step should be removed and delegated entirely to the backend.
title: mdn: two email fetches per send entry (handler + backend)
